title: Make-ahead Marinara Sauce
steps: Put all ingredients into a deep saucepan; bring to boil; stir; simmer 40 minutes.
Blitz with a hand blender until smooth; pour into a large 1-litre jar.
Cool; keep in fridge up to 5 days, or freeze in portions.
notes: Use as pasta sauce, pizza sauce, or stir into cooked mince and onions for a quick Bolognese. Slow cooker: all ingredients in, cook on high 4 hours or low 8 hours.
source: The Slimming Foodie by Pip Payne (2021, Aster/Octopus)
